title: AgentCore MCP Tool Output Schema Binding Contract
description: Binds every upstream server in contracts/bifrost-upstream-mcp-registry.json to an output-schema profile so tools/list can advertise tool.outputSchema and tool results can carry conforming structuredContent. No secrets, no per-tool payload dumps.

envelope_schema_path.description: Repo-relative path to the canonical envelope JSON Schema.

envelope_version.description: Must equal envelope_version inside the envelope schema file.

detail.description: compact (default, ~1.5KB/tool) strips descriptions. minimal (~0.5KB/tool) also collapses the evidence/error/meta item shapes and the family data hints; structuredContent still validates. full keeps descriptions and is for review only.

max_structured_bytes.description: Upper bound on upstream text considered for JSON->data promotion.

structured_from_text_json.description: Promote JSON-in-text results into envelope.data. Text content blocks are always preserved.

max_output_schema_bytes.description: Validator ceiling for a single advertised outputSchema (minified).

family.description: Key under $defs.family_data in the envelope schema.

adapter.description: stdio_envelope = renderer wraps the stdio launch with the AgentCore normalizer. upstream_native = upstream already advertises outputSchema and emits conforming structuredContent. unsupported = no normalization path (must stay out of every capability profile).

tool_profiles.description: Per-tool profile overrides for tools whose payload family differs from the server default.

reason.description: Required justification when adapter is unsupported.
